source.title: Reconcile C2/C3 worker terminal state with verified outcomes
source.objective: Converge repository/test evidence with canonical worker, run, thread, and turn terminal state so useful completed work is not reported failed and stale in-progress turns do not trigger needless rework.
source.acceptance_json: ["Terminal reconciliation uses canonical repository/test and worker state evidence.", "Verified completed work cannot remain falsely failed or in progress after reconciliation."]
